text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we did it! 
I took first place!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching? 
I gave everything you taught me out there!
choice_data_list:
Congratulations! We've got great news to 
share with everyone back home!

Congratulations! We've got great news to 
share with everyone back home!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! You're right! 
Hehe, I hope it brings a smile to their 
faces.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even before today's race, I received so 
many 
messages of encouragement from everyone in 
Hidaka.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Give it your all, Daring Tact!" 
"We're cheering for you with all our 
might!" 
"You're our pride and joy."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Reading those made my desire to win 
grow stronger and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm truly glad that I could live up 
to their expectations!
choice_data_list:
Let's tell them right away and share the 
joy of victory!
Let's bring them even more victories!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Good idea. I'll thank everyone right away—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look at all the congratulatory 
messages already!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Do you think I managed to repay them, 
even just a little?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I will become much stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So please, push me without mercy. 
I promise I will overcome whatever you 
throw at me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will keep stacking up 
more and more victories...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So everyone can proudly boast, 
"She grew up right here with us"—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to become an umamusume 
who stands as the true pride of Hidaka!
